necessary_context.content: G is a compact convex body in R^n with nonempty interior; V(G) consists of continuous convex functions. For nonconstant f, the metric is (f(x)-min_G f)/(max_G f-min_G f). One exact evaluation of f at a chosen x in G counts as one operation. Section 2 defines nu(G,epsilon) for 0<epsilon<1/2.
necessary_context.name: Relative-error value model

necessary_context.applies_to: Volume certificate and interpretation of localization
necessary_context.content: The source defines a convex body G'(y) contained in G such that f(t)>=f(y) for every t in G outside G'(y). If Vol(G'(y))<=epsilon^n Vol(G), it states that y has relative error at most epsilon, attributing this implication to reference [1]. The measurable-set extension in thm.P034.volume_relative_gap is accompanied by a separate local Proof and does not depend on adopting the unread reference [1].
necessary_context.name: Localization certificate
